Cost: Monthly membership. Basic from £30+VAT/month (no leads). Lead plans reported £100 to £300/month.
Free citation?: No. Profiles show name and town, no phone or website link.
Vetting: Up to 12 checks: ID, address, qualifications, CCJs, company history, directors, reviews elsewhere
Eligible niches: Trades and home services. Pet services not confirmed.
Notes: Biggest UK trade directory and now owns the Rated People brand. Weak as a citation (no link), worth it for leads.

Cost: Yearly membership, price on application (reported £600 to £1,000+/year). No lead fees.
Vetting: 5+ references, insurance, Gas Safe/NICEIC/Part P where relevant. Places capped per trade and area.
Notes: Capped membership per area with waiting lists.

Cost: Free to join. Fee per shortlisted lead, roughly £2 to £35+ by job size.
Free citation?: Partly. Free profile; public NAP and website link not confirmed.
Vetting: ID, trade evaluation, right to work, insurance declared
Eligible niches: Building and home trades. Not pet services.
Notes: We can set up the free profile; the client only pays if they take leads.

Cost: Trade accounts reportedly closed 16 Sep 2026; brand bought by Checkatrade Group.
Free citation?: No. No new trade sign-ups reported.
Notes: Closure reported by one third-party source only. Check before advising a client.

Cost: £248 assessment, then £69/£89/£124 a month by staff count.
Vetting: Strongest vetting: insurance, ID, director DBS, credit history, assessor visit, customer references
Eligible niches: Home improvement and repairs. Not pet services.
Notes: Premium trust badge. Costly for small trades but a strong proof point.

Cost: £40/year plus the scheme provider's fee (usually a trade body).
Free citation?: No. Listing follows paid scheme registration.
Vetting: Assessed by the scheme provider; workmanship guarantees, insurance
Eligible niches: Trades with a licensed scheme provider. Not pet services.
Notes: Mainly useful for retrofit and energy work, or where the client's trade body already offers it.

Cost: Free sign-up. Leads cost credits (£1.80+VAT each).
Free citation?: Partly. Profile shows name, areas, website and email; no address or phone.
Eligible niches: Trades and pet services (dog walking, pet sitting, dog grooming)
Notes: Free profile with a website link. One of few platforms open to pet businesses.

Cost: Application fee plus annual fee by size (e.g. Dorset £305/year, 0 to 5 staff, ex VAT).
Vetting: Trading Standards checks, DBS for staff entering homes, complaint history
Eligible niches: Any reputable business in a participating council area. Pet services not confirmed.
Notes: Council-backed scheme, only where the client's council takes part. See Local Networks.

Cost: Free basic account. Houzz Pro reported £139/month.
Free citation?: Yes. Name, address, website and service areas.
Eligible niches: Design and build trades (landscapers, builders, kitchens, roofers). Not pet services.
Notes: Free listing with a link. Strong for landscaping and home improvement.

Cost: Pay per lead (price not published). Free month trial.
Free citation?: Partly. Free profile; public NAP and link not confirmed.
Eligible niches: Home trades. Pet services not confirmed.
Notes: Mid-size lead site with a free profile.
